notes.title: Avatar Customization Survey
notes.content:
Hello heroes!

We've received feedback indicating that [b]AVATAR CUSTOMIZATION[/b] highly anticipated by the community. Currently, our options for customizations are quite limited, and we aim to explore ways to enhance this aspect of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12074189/c31cc8406e6ccdd86c6ebd0932b3062a106e495f.jpg[/img]

Recently, we evaluated areas of the game where we could potentially expand customization options. Player avatars were identified as having significant potential for enhancement. However, to provide more individualization options, we would need to modify the current avatar design to make it more unified.
To gather your feedback, we’ve prepared a survey showcasing our plans. You can access the survey directly from the character selection screen in-game. Please note that in-game surveys are only available if your characters are linked to an S&F account and this time you need to own at least one character with level 10+.

Want more detailed information about avatar customization? Feel free to check out our related blog post here: https://home.sfgame.net/blog/dev-blog/considering-enhanced-avatar-customization.

Thank you very much! We appreciate your effort and opinion!

notes.title: Closed Plague Doctor Beta: Second Iteration
notes.content:
Hello heroes!

In the upcoming week, we will be hosting the second iteration of the [b]CLOSED PLAGUE DOCTOR BETA[/b]. During this test, our primary goal is to assess whether the Plague Doctor's abilities meet players' expectations and how enjoyable it feels to play this class after it was adjusted based on community feedback. Additionally, we aim to determine if this class is well-balanced and integrates seamlessly into the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12074189/75dd8724f5ad49984dc1e933102f4a87596683a9.jpg[/img]

Here is what has been changed:
- The Plague Doctor now has a permanent evasion chance of 20%.
- The cooldown period between poisonings has been removed; however, players will need to wait until their opponent is no longer under the effects of poison before throwing a tincture will be possible again.
- There is now a single type of tincture, which inflicts a poisoning duration of 3 rounds. During this time, the poisoning effect, which enhances the Plague Doctor's evasion chance, and the damage dealt by the tincture will gradually diminish as the duration increases.

This closed beta will happen from August 13th to 20th, 2025.
To offer you a chance to participate in closed beta tests, we will distribute a [b]code via ingame message on August 13th, 2025[/b], from 10 AM CEST that allows up to 2,500 registrations. First come, first served. Once the limit is reached, it may no longer be possible to sign up for the beta server. Some individual access codes will be distributed on Twitch and YouTube. Keep an eye out!

notes.title: Closed Beta Test — New Class: Plague Doctor
notes.content: [p]In the upcoming week, we will be hosting a closed beta test to introduce and evaluate the new class, the Plague Doctor.[/p][p]During the initial test, our primary goal is to assess whether the Plague Doctor's abilities meet players' expectations and how enjoyable it feels to play this class. Additionally, we aim to determine if this class is well-balanced and integrates seamlessly into the game.[/p][p]Here is some information about the Plague Doctor:[/p][p]Plague Doctors have a 55% chance to throw one of three toxic tinctures at an enemy, provided the enemy is not already poisoned. The thrown bottle can be blocked or dodged, but the tincture's damage-over-time effect cannot be avoided. Upon impact, the bottle deals immediate damage to the enemy, while the tincture inflicts ongoing damage for a specific number of turns. At the start of each round, poisoned enemies take additional damage from the active tincture before the Plague Doctor's attack.[/p][p]The duration, damage, and dodge chance associated with each tincture vary depending on the specific type used. However, if a Plague Doctor is defeated, the tincture's effect on their enemy is immediately removed.[/p][p]This closed beta will happen from July 9th to 16th, 2025.[/p][p]To offer you a chance to participate in closed beta tests, we will distribute a code via ingame message on July 9th, 2025, at 10 AM CEST that allows up to 2,500 registrations. First come, first served. Once the limit is reached, it may no longer be possible to sign up for the beta server. Some individual access codes will be distributed on Twitch and YouTube. Keep an eye out![/p][p]Keep in mind: Closed Betas can only be accessed via browser.[/p]

notes.title: Producer's Note #33
notes.content:
We would like to provide you with some information about why there were issues with server stability during the start of the game world EU20 and what measures we have already taken to avoid such situations in the future.

With the introduction of the new backend in 2022 and a server architecture that includes multiple game servers that automatically take over the work of a failed server, we have already taken a step towards a generally more stable system; for example, daily complete data backups have since been eliminated.

Basically, our systems operate with a performance that is well above the average required capacity, so performance spikes can usually be well managed even during server startups, as recent history has shown.

In this specific case, however, there was unexpectedly high load during the EU20 server start, caused by several factors that led to an overload. Our SSO server, which had to process logins as well as a high number of Twitch drop and coupon code redemptions, was particularly affected. We suspect that this constellation posed a challenge for the SSO server. Additionally, we were simultaneously dealing with a hardware defect.

Ultimately, we were able to resolve the issues by scaling up the SSO servers, and we will continue to run them with the same performance – even though we do not normally need this.

Our system administrators and developers are working diligently to further adapt our technology. The goal is to improve the stability of our systems to ensure a smooth gaming experience and minimize downtime. We thank you for your understanding and patience.

notes.title: Why Rewards Have Been Redistributed in the Hellevator
notes.content:
Analyzing the recent Hellevator events and the feedback received has shown us that some players tend to move up and down in specific floor ranges to farm fruits and maximize their gold gainings. We recognize that players may develop unique strategies during a Hellevator event to distinguish themselves, and we fully appreciate and support that creativity.

On the other hand, it is understandable that this strategy can make the event feel less enjoyable, as it often leads to monotonous gameplay and seems to contradict the spirit of competitive play. This means that instead of simply aiming to advance as far as possible in the Hellevator for the best rewards, players may need to adopt the aforementioned strategy to achieve optimum gains.

As a result, we randomized the rewards of the opponents and the distribution of fruits, ensuring that advancing in the Hellevator feels even more rewarding for everyone involved.

While it may initially seem otherwise, we want to reassure you that the total rewards distributed during the event have remained consistent. We understand that the distribution of different types of fruits could have been better optimized, and we genuinely appreciate your feedback on this matter. This is something we will thoughtfully consider for the next iteration of the Hellevator.

Exciting news to share: the final Hellevator rewards have been enhanced! The gold reward has seen an increase, and you can now also earn additional resources, including Arcane Splinters and Metal.

notes.title: Producer's Note #32
notes.content:
In recent months, we have been intensively working with community feedback and addressing bugs, which has been largely received positively. At this point, we want to assure you that we are also working on content that goes beyond mere quality-of-life improvements. We have heard your concerns and would like to give you an overview of what you can expect throughout the year.

Through the recent and upcoming closed beta tests, as well as the class survey, it is known that we are working on an expansion of the Arcane Toilet and the introduction of a new class, the Plague Doctor. This new class will be presented in a closed beta, allowing you to share your opinions and enabling us to make adjustments before the release.

In line with our motto for this year, "Back to the Community," we are currently developing a survey tool that will allow us to interact with you directly in the game and better evaluate your feedback. In the future, to participate in a survey, you will no longer need to leave the game and can conduct the survey in your chosen language. This survey function allows us to specifically gather feedback from certain player groups, for example, from all players who have fully upgraded their fortress.

A new weekend event, the World Boss, is currently in development. In this event, the entire game world will work together to protect the game world from a World Boss.

Furthermore, we will respond to the community's request and expand the existing dungeons by five dungeons. Additionally, the dependency of stamina's influence on the bonus length of the Bard's melody of vigor will be removed.

In addition to the above-mentioned content, new ideas are already being refined. We will keep you updated as soon as we are confident that these projects can be implemented.

notes.title: Beta 16.0 - Arcane Toilet
notes.content:
[b]CLOSED BETA 16.0: Arcane Toilet[/b]

In the upcoming week, we will host a closed beta test in which we are testing the next iteration of to the Arcane Toilet feature. In the following we will explain the adjustments made due to player feedback which was received during the last closed beta test and beyond.

[b]Runtime: May 21-28, 2025[/b]
[b]Platform: browser version only![/b] 

To offer you a chance to participate in closed beta tests, we will distribute a code via ingame message on May 21st, 2025, at 10 AM CEST that allows up to 2,500 registrations. First come, first served. Once the limit is reached, it may no longer be possible to sign up for the beta server. Some individual access codes will be distributed on Twitch and YouTube. Keep an eye out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12074189/83c77f88954efb93d84b1e8f237b37a893399b09.jpg[/img]

[b]Changelog:[/b]

General

- The Aura level will be capped at 500 levels, and the Mana values required to reach an Aura level have been adjusted.
- The higher the item quality, the higher the attributes.
- The weapon damage has been adjusted and increases less sharply at high item quality.

Sacrificing

- Up to Aura level 229, one item can be sacrificed, up to Aura level 399, two items can be sacrificed, and starting from Aura level 400, three items can be sacrificed per day.
- The efficiency factor of a sacrifice is always 100%.
- Sacrificing epic and legendary items yields 50 Mana each, while the other Mana values remain unchanged.
- Items without gold value can now also be sacrificed.
- Spillover ensures no mana is wasted if the generated amount doesn't precisely match the required level completion.
- Upon item sacrifice, you'll receive back the materials used for upgrades.

Washing

- Washing no longer generates Mana.
- Washed items retain their gold value but cannot be washed again and receive a corresponding mark.
- Improvements made to weapons that are washed will be transferred to the new weapon, so invested resources are not lost, and in the case of a sale, disassembly, or sacrifice, they will be refunded according to the usual rules.

notes.title: Closed Beta — Follow-Up
notes.content:
We extend our gratitude for your participation in the closed beta and for your valuable, constructive feedback. Your insights are very helpful.

Based on your suggestions, we plan to refine the feature and will share the updates in an upcoming closed beta in the near future. We're unable to set a precise date, as the timeline for implementing changes remains uncertain. Rest assured, this feature will not be included in the next major update.
Here's a summary of the issues we'll address based on your feedback:
[list]
[*] Arcane toilet completion time is excessive: We'll adjust so it won't exceed twice the time needed to reach aura level 66 in the current system.
[*] Mana generation from item sacrifice: To prevent the need for transmogging for a maximum output, epic and legendary items will yield equal mana.
[*] Introducing spillover: This ensures no mana is wasted if the generated amount doesn't precisely match the required level completion.
[*] Return of upgrade materials: Upon item sacrifice, you'll receive back the materials used for upgrades.
[/list]
Other issues that need to be carefully examined include the disproportionate weapon damage caused by aura levels and the resulting impact on power scaling, the daily limit on the number of items that can be sacrificed, the loss of upgrade resources and gems upon making a sacrifice, and the stage in the game at which the toilet becomes truly relevant.

Regarding the issue of sacrificing gold-valued items, we view this as a strategic gameplay element, offering players a choice between using the item in the arcane toilet or throwing it into the witches cauldron to spent gained gold on attributes.

Your feedback continues to shape our game, and we appreciate your ongoing involvement.

notes.title: Closed Beta Test – Arcane Toilet Upgrade
notes.content:
From Wednesday, March 19th, 2025, we will host a closed beta test for 7 days in which we are testing enhancements to the Arcane Toilet feature. The updated feature now offers two distinct functions: item sacrifice and item wash.

Sacrificing an item will increase mana, albeit with diminishing returns for each additional item sacrificed within the same day. As the item is consumed, flushing the toilet will boost your aura level and generate a new item. We have raised the maximum aura level to 1,000. Furthermore, we are introducing 'item quality,' which indicates an item's strength. Flushing the toilet will also enhance item quality.

Washing an item will alter its armor or weapon class. However, this process will remove the selling value, and any upgrades previously applied to weapons will result in a loss of invested resources. The first wash of the day will generate mana at full efficiency.

We understand that reworking an existing feature may not be universally welcomed. Therefore, we are presenting this rework during the closed beta phase. Our aim with this beta is to gauge player reception and determine whether the revamped Arcane Toilet is appreciated as a valuable new gameplay element within Shakes & Fidget. Certainly, we would like to identify any errors or problems that may occur during the test.

After the feature has reached a stage where it meets player expectations, it will be launched. We will ensure that a substantial period of time has elapsed between this release and the most recent Legendary Dungeon.

To give you a chance to participate in Closed Beta Tests, we will distribute a code that allows up to 2,500 registrations. Some personal access codes will be distributed on Twitch.

The closed beta server can only be accessed via Browser but not the Steam client itself.

notes.title: Procuder’s Note #31.1 - Alpha Group – Our Approach to Early Feedback
notes.content:
During the early years of Shakes & Fidget, our testing process was informal, relying on Community Managers and engaged players to identify issues and provide input. As our game and vision grew, we saw the need for a more structured approach.

In 2023, we strengthened our Quality Assurance (QA) process with a dedicated internal team in QA and Development. A key turning point was the introduction of a Peer Group, originally formed to assist with server fusions and class balance discussions. This group quickly proved invaluable, providing feedback on new content such as the Sandstorm Dungeon before its release.

Recognizing their impact, we formalized their role and renamed them the Alpha Group. Their access to internal test servers and direct communication with our Game Design team allows us to gather crucial early-stage feedback on new content and features. The Alpha Group helps us fine-tune ideas, anticipate gameplay impacts, and detect bugs before broader testing begins.

A recent feature rework greatly benefited from their early involvement. The feedback we received encouraged us to remove certain behaviors from the rework concept, ensuring that long-term players would appreciate the enhancements implemented. The Alpha Group will continue to play a pivotal role in the testing phase before the feature moves into Beta and will be officially announced.

Their contributions enable us to pinpoint critical bugs and gain valuable insights into actual player behavior regarding various features. This collaboration ensures that our updates are well-received and polished before reaching the live servers.

Stay tuned for next week’s Producer's Note, where we will share insights regarding the personnel structure of the Alpha group.

In reaction to that, internal processes have been reviewed and reorganized with the goal to release content by including the community more closely, striving for higher quality and acceptance.

Around the same time, an open letter published on Discord by Vaaz drew our attention where the community voiced their frustration with the game’s quality and direction. We would like to thank you for your open words, and we are grateful for such a dedicated community. We are confident that we will find answers for your demands with our new processes.

Change takes time but you can expect even more surveys regarding new and existing game features. The outcome of surveys will be communicated more transparently. We will intensify our cooperation with content creators and peer groups of experienced and dedicated community members to constantly gather feedback during the whole production phase and beyond. Of course, this will include open and/or closed beta tests as well.

While the issues raised in the open letter have been addressed during the Twitch stream, we want to highlight that several concerns mentioned in the letter, along with additional community requests, have already been resolved with the release of update 24.000 today. For more detailed information, please check our changelog: [url=https://playa-games.helpshift.com/hc/faq/406/]https://playa-games.helpshift.com/hc/faq/406/[/url].

Moreover, this year's event cycle has been designed based on community feedback to ensure it is more diverse and beneficial during the scheduled events. For instance, the witches’ dance event was introduced this weekend in response to the Sandstorm extension release.

notes.title: Producer's Note #29
notes.content:
[h3]Does the Paladin Make the Warrior Obsolete?
[/h3]Since the introduction of the Paladin class, we have received feedback expressing concerns that the Warrior class has become obsolete. Many players feel that the Paladin is stronger, leaving the Warrior as one of the weakest classes in the game.

We are currently exploring ways to enhance the Warrior class to make it more competitive; however, we are encountering several challenges. One significant issue is that the existing classes in dungeons are not straightforward to adjust. Any changes made would impact every dungeon where these classes are encountered.

To effectively improve the Warrior class, we first need to separate the PvE and PvP systems within the game. This separation would allow us to better feature other classes in dungeons, ultimately enriching the gameplay experience for all players.

[h3]Comment on Fusion Compensation
[/h3]The compensation strategy is designed to promote competition and innovation on future fused game worlds. It is grounded on the analysis of competitive characters, with compensation levels at approximately two-thirds of the potential experience (XP) players could earn in a specific period.

For gold, the compensation is set at about one-third of the total gold attainable by players, aligning with what a free-to-play (f2p) gamer could accumulate. While multiple formulas could be used to calculate gold from various activities like city guard, gold pit, and expeditions, a single formula based on expeditions has been chosen for its simplicity and lower risk of errors, ensuring the compensated gold amount remains consistent.

[h3]No New Server in January
[/h3]While some may be anticipating a new server launch in January, we want to inform you that we have decided not to release a new server this month. The next server launch is expected to occur in February.

notes.title: Producer's Note #28
notes.content:
In 2025, we will continue with the fusion of game worlds as announced. The affected game worlds will be informed well in advance.

After the last fusions, we received valuable feedback from the community. It was noted that the age differences between the game worlds and the characters within them pose a disadvantage for the younger characters. They have a hard time remaining competitive in the fused game world.

To mitigate these disadvantages, we will take the following measures from now on when game worlds are fused:
[list]
[*] Level-Ups: For each game world that is part of a fusion, the time between its own server launch and the server launch of the oldest game world in the fusion will be calculated in months (rounded to 0.5 months). The resulting factor will be multiplied by 2 to determine the number of levels by which a character will be increased.
[*] Gold Bonus: The aforementioned time factor will also be taken into account here. Additionally, the character level immediately before the merger will play a role in calculating the gold bonus. Roughly speaking, one receives approximately the amount of gold per month that one would obtain from expeditions if one spends 320 adventure points on about 25 days in the month, with the Dragon Griffin/Griffin Dragon being active.
[/list]
With this measure, we aim to promote fairer competition in fused game worlds and make the gaming experience in these worlds more attractive.

notes.title: Producer’s Note #27

Here is a quick recap of our collaboration with the Friendly Fire Event.

Through sales of the Friendly Fire Frame we raised an incredible 9,990€, and an additional $439.88 (approximately 418.94€) during the official Twitch stream on December 7th. These funds will go directly to supporting impactful causes. The Friendly Fire Frame sold out in record time—less than an hour! Just 50 minutes after its release, the frame was no longer available. Your contributions are making a real difference in the lives of many.

Friendly Fire is an annual charity livestream event in Germany, organized by prominent streamers and content creators. It unites a diverse group of gaming and streaming personalities to play live games, master unique challenges, and engage in fun campaigns—all while raising money for various charitable causes. Known for its dynamic mix of entertainment, community spirit, and generosity, Friendly Fire has become a hallmark event in the gaming world.

After this year’s success, we are excited to announce that we’re planning to participate in the Friendly Fire Event again next year! We’re already brainstorming ways to make it even more extraordinary, with new opportunities for you to get involved. Stay tuned as we finalize plans and share more details. Your continued support is what makes this all possible. Thank you for being a part of this amazing journey. notes.title: Producer’s Note #26.1 - Survey Results Pt. 1
notes.content:
Over the past few weeks, we have sought your feedback through several surveys. We want to share the results of the first batch of surveys with you and outline the actions we will take as a result.

The improvements mentioned below will be part of the upcoming update (version 22.700).
[h3]Hellevator - Leaving a Guild or Being Kicked From a Guild Will Be Restricted[/h3]
We inquired whether we should trial a Hellevator event with added restrictions. This idea received support from the majority of participants. As a result, we will prohibit guild members from leaving their guild while the Hellevator event is active. However, members will be permitted to leave once the event concludes and the reward claim phase begins. Guild members will be protected from being kicked out during the event, although characters that are deleted will be removed.
[h3]Character Screen Displayed in International Hall of Fame[/h3]
There was a consensus to include character screens in the international hall of fame. This feature will be implemented.
[h3]Guild War - Attacking and Defending Guild Members Visible to All[/h3]
To enhance visibility regarding the presence of attacking and defending guild members before a guild fight, feedback suggests that everyone should have the ability to view both defenders and attackers within the guild member list. We're taking action to incorporate this feature to ensure that everyone has access to this information.
[h3]Inserting Gems on Items Without Socket[/h3]
Currently, if you attempt to insert a gem into an item that lacks a socket, you must visit the blacksmith to add a socket to the item before you can insert the gem.

Community feedback suggests that it would be more convenient to add a socket to an item in the same step as inserting a gem. We have listened to this feedback and will implement a function that allows adding a gem and creating a socket in a single action.

notes.title: Closed Beta Test – The Paladin 2.0
notes.content:
We are excited to test the revised Paladin class, which has been updated based on feedback from the community.

The Paladin now possesses a healing ability, and we are eager to learn if this change meets your expectations and ensures the class is competitive with others. [*] Max. damage reduction: 83.3 % (was 72 %)
[*] Damage factor: 45 % (was 55 %)
[*] Defensive Stance: Shield of Faith
[list]

[/list]

[list]

notes.title: Producer's Note #25
notes.content:
[h3]What Will Happen With the Traveling Circus[/h3]
During last weekend's traveling circus event, some balancing issues arose, including a level mismatch and a missing resource cap, which potentially allowed some players to gain an unfair advantage. Consequently, we made the decision to cancel the event after only two days.

We plan to host the event again; however, before we do, we will conduct a thorough review of our tracking data along with your feedback. Based on this information, we will make adjustments to the balancing to guarantee an enjoyable and fair experience for all players. In line with the changes, we will implement a cap on rewards and reduce the event's duration, transforming it into an exclusive weekend event. Stay tuned for further updates!

[h3]Upcoming Paladin Closed Beta[/h3]
We are currently integrating your feedback into the Paladin class, with a primary focus on adding a healing ability. We also plan to conduct another closed beta session in mid-November to demonstrate the Paladin's latest iteration.

Furthermore, we will increase the number of available spots to 2,500, allowing an even greater number of players to experience the test phase.

[h3]Game World Selection for Fusions[/h3]
Once we start to fusion servers which have been started in 2022, we will include game worlds that have opened within a six-month period (either in the first or second half of the year) to ensure a more equitable distribution of character progression. This change will result in two fusions occurring annually.

notes.title: Closed Beta Test – New Class: Paladin
notes.content:
In this beta, we are testing the new class: the Paladin. The Paladin is a shield class with high defense, which benefits from long battles.

The Paladin has an ability that can assume three different shield stances in combat (when a shield is equipped; inactive against mages):

[h3]Neutral Stance[/h3]
[list]
[*] no effect
[*] 50% chance to switch to defensive stance
[/list]
[h3]Defensive Stance[/h3]
[list]
[*] damage reduction: +11%
[*] 50% chance to switch to offensive stance
[/list]
[h3]Offensive Stance[/h3]
[list]
[*] damage factor +35%
[*] 50% chance to switch to neutral stance
[/list]
[h2]Closed Beta Facts[/h2]
To give you a chance to participate in Closed Beta Tests, we will distribute a code that allows up to 1,000 registrations. First come, first served. Once the limit is reached, it may no longer be possible to sign up on the Beta server. Some personal access codes will be distributed on Twitch and YouTube. Keep your eyes open!

The next Closed Beta will start on Wednesday, October 9, 2024 at 12 PM (CEST) and will run for 7 days.

With the Closed Beta Test, we want to find out whether the new Paladin class has an appropriate strength compared to the other classes and whether the class needs to be improved in certain areas.

There are no class restrictions in the Closed Beta; the assigned character level is at least 300. The following features are unlocked:
[list]
[*] All enchantments
[*] All dungeons (not completed)
[*] Arena Manager
[*] Stronghold
[*] Underworld
[*] Pets, including all habitats
[*] Full sticker book
[/list]
The Mushroom Dealer is not available.
[h2]Other Adjustments and Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Warrior will now block damage with a 25% chance instead of up to 25 %.
[*] For characters who start the beta with at least level 300 the available dungeons will no longer be completed. And the treasury will be upgraded to the maximum.
[/list]

notes.title: Producer’s Note #24
notes.content:
Florian, the Head of Quality Assurance at Playa Games, explains why the world of F9 receives updates faster and why its time has been shifted one day into the future.

Developers and testers at Shakes & Fidget review all new features, fixed bugs, and important core functions before release. Testing and stabilizing hotfixes can take hours to days. Untested versions are only released in emergencies, such as critical cases. To still be able to deliver hotfixes quickly and securely, there is a tight timeframe.

Regarding F9: There are technical differences between internal test and live worlds. The internal test worlds are more unstable and change frequently. Beta participants know that things don't always go smoothly there. These pre-versions are not meant to be deployed on live worlds. Therefore, a new version is installed on the F9 one day before all other worlds to ensure it functions stably.

One reason for the time shift is the identical representation of events and tasks as if it were already the next day. After installation, routine checks are carried out, but simulating the actual gameplay behavior of players is difficult. Real feedback is therefore crucial. The F9 serves as a buffer to detect configuration errors before the broad rollout.

Why the F9? Previously, the S31DE was used for this system, which merged with the F9 due to low activity. The F9 was small, active, and met all requirements. In hindsight, earlier communication to the players would have been sensible. However, the version usually does not stay on the F9 for long.

Player feedback is crucial to improving Playa Games' games. It should always be considered that employees can also make mistakes.

notes.title: Closed Beta Test –Druid and Demon Hunter Adjustments
notes.content:
In this beta, we are testing adjustments to the Druid class. Now, when in bear form and the Gladiator is active, the Druid deals increased damage. Additionally, in eagle form, the Swoop Attack is performed alongside the regular attack, but the damage has been reduced to 61% (previously 77.5%). Moreover, a bug has been fixed to ensure that critical hits in bear form will now deal the expected critical damage.

The Demon Hunter's chance to revive will now decrease by 11% after each revival (previously a reduction of 2%).

[h3]Closed Beta Facts[/h3]
To offer you a chance to participate in closed beta tests, we will distribute a code that allows up to 500 registrations. First come, first served. Once the limit is reached, it may no longer be possible to sign up for the beta server. Some individual access codes will be distributed on Twitch and YouTube. Keep an eye out!
The next closed beta will start on Monday, August 12, 2024, at 12 pm (CEST) and run for 7 days.

With the closed beta test, we want to determine if the adjusted versions of the Druid and Demon Hunter have an appropriate strength compared to other classes and if there are aspects of these classes that need improvement.

There are no class restrictions in the closed beta; the assigned character level is at least 300. The following features are unlocked:
[list]
[*] All enchantments
[*] All dungeon keys
[*] Arena Manager
[*] Fortress

[/list]
The Mushroom dealer will not be available.

notes.title: Producer’s Note #21.6
notes.content:
Welcome to the sixth installment of our producer's notes, where we focus on the UI/UX enhancements made to the Smith and Witch features in Shakes & Fidget. These changes are designed to streamline interactions and improve the overall usability of these essential game elements.
[h3]Smith Feature Update[/h3]
We've centralized all smith interactions within the smith feature itself, using tabs to separate different functionalities. This eliminates the need for pop-ups after selecting an interaction, allowing for a more integrated and seamless experience. Players can now enjoy a clearer overview and faster navigation, making the process of upgrading and modifying equipment more intuitive.
[h3]Witch Feature Redesign[/h3]
The witch's screen has undergone significant restructuring, with her three main interactions now divided across three distinct tabs. This change enhances the accessibility of each functionality and simplifies the user interface.

The most notable improvements have been made to the enchantment process. Our goal was to make accessing and understanding enchantments easier, ensuring players recognize that they are enhancing their gear. The new tabbed layout supports this by providing a more straightforward and user-friendly approach to applying enchantments.

These updates to the Smith and Witch features are part of our ongoing effort to improve game interaction and provide a more enjoyable and effective experience.

Stay tuned for our final note, where we'll conclude our series on UI/UX improvements.

notes.title: Producer’s Note #21.4
notes.content:
Welcome to the fourth installment of our producer's notes, where we delve into the UI/UX rework of the character screen and backpack. This update aims to enhance user interaction and streamline the accessibility of game features.
[h3]Character Screen Modifications[/h3]
The upper part of the character screen remains largely unchanged to maintain familiarity. However, we've restructured the bottom section into three distinct parts, improving overall navigation and making it easier to interact with other players directly – actions like fighting and comparing stats are now more accessible.
[h3]Backpack Enhancements[/h3]
We've relocated the backpack to the bottom of the mobile character screen. This adjustment required a redesign of the layout for other screens to ensure a cohesive user experience. The new, large scrollable backpack format replaces the traditional chests, offering a more intuitive and space-efficient way to manage items.

The backpack now operates context-sensitively, enhancing item interaction based on the screen you're viewing:
[list]
[*] In your character view, items unsuitable for your class are marked as "no interaction possible”, helping you manage your inventory efficiently.
[*] When accessing the smith screen, each item displays the resources you'll gain upon dismantling, making decision-making simpler.
[*] On the toilet screen, items that can be discarded are clearly indicated, streamlining the cleanup process.
[/list]
These changes are designed to make the game interface both visually appealing and user-friendly, improving the overall gaming experience.

Stay tuned for further insights in our upcoming producer's notes, where we will continue to explore more aspects of our comprehensive UI/UX rework. Next up: the guild.

notes.title: Producer’s Note #21.3
notes.content:
Welcome to the third installment of our producer's notes, focusing on the UI/UX rework of our game's menu and city map. This update aims to enhance navigation and interactive elements for a seamless gaming experience.
[h3]Menu Enhancements[/h3]
We've introduced categories with dynamic feature icons to simplify navigation. Previously, over 20 features were listed in one view, which was cumbersome. Now, features are grouped by category with icons indicating their state – news, upgrade, progress, or locked. This visual differentiation improves orientation and gameplay efficiency.

Key features like the Legendary Dungeon and Hellevator are now easily accessible in the menu. For mobile users, the bottom menu bar dynamically adjusts based on the selected category, streamlining transitions and interactions within individual feature screens.
[h3]City Map Redesign[/h3]
The city map is redesigned to represent each game feature as a building, adding engagement and providing a comprehensive overview of functionalities. The map also shows the various icon states of each feature, allowing players to quickly assess their progress and updates directly from the map.

These updates create a more organized and visually appealing interface that enhances both aesthetics and usability. Stay tuned for our next note, where we'll explore changes for the character screen and backpack in detail.

notes.title: Producer’s Note #21.2
notes.content:
Welcome to the second installment of our seven-part series on our game’s UI/UX rework. This note addresses the general adjustments needed based on your feedback and our own observations.
[h3]Menu Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dual-feature Buttons: Currently, some buttons host two features, requiring double presses, which is unintuitive. This setup results in unequal feature access and lacks clear notifications for each function.
[*] Expansion Constraints: Our existing design limits the ability to add new features.
[/list]
[h3]City Map Usability[/h3]
[list]
[*] Feature Representation: Essential elements like the underworld or arena manager are missing, and others are inadequately displayed, making it challenging to navigate the game map.
[/list]
[h3]Tutorial Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] Overwhelming Text: The tutorial's lengthy texts deter new players. We plan to slightly adjust and simplify the tutorial.
[/list]
[h3]Character Navigation[/h3]
[list]
[*] Complex Layout: The current character screen is not user-friendly. We aim to simplify navigation and manage information more intuitively.
[*] Equipment Management: We’re moving towards a drag-and-drop interface for equipment management, consolidating all items into a single backpack accessible across necessary screens.
[/list]
[h3]Backpack Functionality[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unified Storage: We will streamline storage by using one backpack for all items, reducing confusion and enhancing gameplay.
[/list]
These adjustments will make the game more intuitive and enjoyable. Our next notes will outline specific changes and implementation strategies.

notes.title: Producer’s Note #22
notes.content:
We have observed that the adjustment of the Gold Cap and the reduction of the character level at which this cap becomes effective have been subjects of controversial discussions.

After consultations with various community representatives, including MoZone and the SF Tavern team, we have reviewed all possible options to respond to the situation. We have made the following decision:

The Gold Cap will be maintained at its current level. We communicated the reasons for this decision several weeks ago and we continue to stand by it.

The level at which the Gold Cap applies will be raised to level 632 with Update 22.000, as it was before the change. This means that the cap of 400 million gold, which can be reached with the best mount from expeditions at 100 thirst for adventure, will only apply from character level 632. The gold income will dynamically approach the maximum value.

We have ensured that the gold rewards from expeditions remain on average higher than those from classic adventures.

Update 22.000 is currently scheduled for early July.

notes.title: Producer’s Note #21.1
notes.content:
As we approach the 15th anniversary of Shakes & Fidget this June, we want to announce a comprehensive UI/UX rework that aims to enhance your gaming experience. We have recognized the need for a fresher and more intuitive interface. With the rework of the scrapbook we have already given you a little taste.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12074189/ae3e10dbb35735625378b72a0f8cc2655392a2ab.png[/img]
[h3]Motivation for Change[/h3]
S&F has evolved significantly since its inception regarding gameplay while the menu and player navigation have largely stayed unchanged. In response to feedback and our observations, we've decided it's time for an update that makes the game more accessible and enjoyable on both mobile and PC.
[h3]Our Goals[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game should continue to be fun and easy to navigate, regardless of the device.
[*] We're ensuring new players can easily understand and get into the game without feeling overwhelmed.
[*] Long-time players will enjoy a fresh look while retaining the familiar feel.
[/list]
[h3]Initial Adjustments[/h3]
We first focused on the core aspects:
[list]
[*] Streamlining navigation to be more intuitive.
[*] Reworked tutorial to provide clearer, more engaging entry points for newcomers.
[*] Redesigning character screen and backpack for better clarity and accessibility.
[/list]
[h3]Feature-Specific Adjustments[/h3]
We then moved to enhance major game features to align with our new UI:
[list]
[*] Smith, Witch, and Guild: These key features have received significant updates to fit seamlessly into the new layout.
[/list]
[h3]Minor Feature Tweaks[/h3]
Almost every other feature saw adjustments to improve integration and functionality:
[list]
[*]Arcane Toilet, Shops, Hall of Fame, Underworld, Fortress, Pets, and Arena have been refined to enhance your interaction and enjoyment.
[/list]
We believe these changes will make S&F more enjoyable and accessible to everyone. Stay tuned for further details in our upcoming notes.

notes.title: Producer's Note #19
notes.content:
After a thorough analysis of your feedback on potential changes to the Assassin and Warrior classes, we want to inform you about our decisions and the reasons behind them.

Your opinions on handling secondary weapons were diverse and did not present a clear picture. While a slight majority was in favor of Warriors keeping their shield, there was also a slight majority for Assassins to forgo their secondary weapon. However, implementing these changes would bring a range of technical and design challenges that could negatively impact the gaming experience.

We considered alternative approaches, such as introducing a new weapon type "Sword + Shield". Despite our efforts, these considerations did not lead to the desired outcomes.

After careful consideration, we have decided to keep the Assassin and Warrior classes in their current form. This decision is based on the goal of preserving balance and the gaming experience for everyone while avoiding potential technical and game design complications.

We value your commitment and passion for our game and are always striving to provide a balanced and exciting gaming experience. Your feedback is important to us, and we are grateful for every opinion that helps us improve the game together.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

notes.title: Producer's Note #18
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that Expeditions, initially introduced as a temporary event on selected game worlds, are here to stay as a permanent feature! This decision comes after thoughtful consideration of your gameplay experience and feedback. Here's why we've chosen to make this change:
[h3]Dynamic Gameplay[/h3]
Expeditions introduce deeper decision-making and strategies, enriching your gameplay.
[h3]For Our Veterans[/h3]
We've streamlined the experience to reduce repetitive tasks, making your adventure more about strategy and less about monotonous clicks.
[h3]Welcoming Newcomers[/h3]
Expeditions are designed for immediate immersion, offering an accessible and straightforward path for newcomers to dive into the fun without delays.
[h3]A Gateway to Innovation[/h3]
This transition expands our design capabilities, promising a future filled with exciting new features and updates.
[h3]Benefits of Expeditions Over Quests[/h3]
[h3]Time-Saving[/h3]
Expeditions are designed to be more efficient, allowing you to achieve more with fewer clicks.
[h3]Increased Enjoyment[/h3]
We've focused on making Expeditions not just a feature but an enjoyable experience, enhancing the fun in your daily adventures.
[h3]Direct Rewards[/h3]
Expeditions give you more control over your rewards, ensuring that your efforts are directly reflected in the outcomes.
[h3]Driven by Community Feedback[/h3]
Your input has been invaluable, and the overwhelming support for Expeditions has led us to this moment. This update allows us to continuously evaluate both systems and adapt to your preferences.

You can switch between Expeditions and the traditional quest system at will in the settings. We’re excited for you to experience this new dimension of gameplay and look forward to your feedback.

What else is coming up with release 20.000? Watch on YouTube:

[previewyoutube=1xLgeF9GSuo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Producer's Note #17
notes.content:
Today we would like to inform you about important updates that aim to improve the gaming experience for everyone. We are aware that the support of our Content Creators with free game currency has led to discussions. We want to clarify: The provision of mushrooms is not a gift but rather recognition and appreciation for the hard work and creative effort that our Content Creators put in every day.

Some of you have expressed concerns that this affects competitiveness. We have taken your feedback seriously and introduced a new, automated system to distribute the game currency fairly and evenly. The goal is to create a harmonious gaming experience for everyone.

It's not just about the number of subscribers when it comes to support. We also consider the quality of the content and average viewer numbers, among other things. We want to promote Content Creators who are passionate and dedicated.

With our new system, mushrooms are now distributed according to levels and set caps, striving for a balance between supported characters and the rest of the player field. This ensures that everyone has the same chance of success and that no one unintentionally dominates the leaderboards.

[b]Mushroom Preset[/b] (highest tier)
[list]
[*] Level 2-300: 500 daily mushrooms, level 301-400: 250 daily mushrooms, level 401-500: 125 daily mushrooms, from level 501: 25 daily mushrooms (subject to change)
[*] Starter packs when requirements are fulfilled
[*] Bonus mushrooms: 3,000 for Legendary Dungeons, 1,000 for Hellevators
[/list]
The updates apply immediately to new characters on new servers and will be implemented gradually for existing characters.

We appreciate your passion and the commitment you put into S&F. These changes are a step towards making the game fairer and more exciting for everyone. If you have any questions or suggestions, you can always contact us as usual.

Thank you for your understanding and support!

notes.title: Producer's Note #16
notes.content:

The heart of the Community Portal is the [url=https://home.sfgame.net/#/stats/rankings/heroes/]statistics page[/url], where you can compare yourself with other players across game worlds, view leaderboards, and track the progress of characters without having to have your own character there.

Just yesterday, the Community Portal was expanded with a feature that the community had requested: the ability to filter by attributes as well as game worlds and classes.

As you can see, we are continuously developing the Community Portal. In order to address your wishes, we ask you to share your feedback with us. You can do this on Discord or send your ideas to support.

Read more about the Community Portal in our [url=https://playa-games.helpshift.com/hc/faq/260-what-is-the-community-portal/]help center[/url].

We wish you continued enjoyment in studying the statistics, look forward to your ideas, and don't forget to pick up your weekly free mushroom in the [url=https://home.sfgame.net/#/shop/]WebShop[/url]!

notes.title: Producer's Note #15
notes.content:
[h3]First Game World Fusions Successful[/h3]
The first game world fusions were successful. Thanks to extensive testing, there were no major incidents. This encourages us to conduct future fusions at shorter intervals. In 2024, the speed of merging game worlds will be increased.
[h3]Back and Forth with Fusion 6[/h3]
There were last-minute changes with Fusion 6: Originally, FR1-FR15 were planned, but FR14 and FR15 were later excluded. Our initial focus was on merging all country servers. However, due to community feedback that FR14 and FR15 are newer than other French game worlds, we decided to exclude them for fairness reasons. FR14 and FR15 will later be merged in their own fusion with game worlds of the same age.
[h3]Planned Fusions (subject to change)[/h3]
We have heard the request to publish future fusions. We would like to comply with this request. Below is a list of the currently planned fusions, subject to possible changes:
[list]
[*] Fusion 7: PL7-PL17, estimation: 08 December 2023
[*] Fusion 8: DE5-DE12, estimation: January 2024
[*] Fusion 9: DE25-DE37, estimation: January 2024

notes.title: Update 19.0 and Hellevator
notes.content:
Our [b]NEW UPDATE 19.0[/b] is available now! Here is a sneak peek at what's new:

- New class: Necromancer
- Hellevator: Violence Plain, increased durability of stackable treats and key card Twitch drops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12074189/37f0d589908b254069d0f250d38bb81733e307cc.jpg[/img]

Full list at bottom of post. *

Moreover, next Friday (November 17; on DE31 as early as Nov. 16), the iron [b]HELLEVATOR[/b] doors will open for your guild at 16 CET! While the bloody river must first be preheated to a cozy thousand degrees so that all the violent criminals can simmer in it appropriately, they await your arrival on the Violence Plain with a thirst for blood.

* [b]New features[/b]

o New class: the Necromancer
- Summon undead minions that will support you with their unique skills in battle
- Including sounds and info screen
o Hellevator plain “Violence”
- Enemies, bosses, graphics and texts
- All Hellevator plains are complete now
o Deleting the S&F account and player data is now possible via the in-game options → deletion will be marked for 30 days (also for single characters that should be deleted from an S&F account) and executed automatically if you do not log in in the meantime
o Twitch Drops
- Drops can contain key cards for the Hellevator now

[b]Improvements[/b]

o Daily tasks
- Can be viewed via a second click on the mail button just like the old list
-- Mobile: golden goblin icon on the mail screen, bottom bar
- The achievement “Special Agent” was adjusted so that you need to collect 200 daily reward packs instead of completing 100 secret missions of the day now → if the old achievement has already been started or was completed, the progress is taken over
- Reworked the Goblin Gleeman graphics and optimized his location on the town screen
- Improved animations when opening reward packs
- When completing the task that requires arena manager attractions to be upgraded with money several times, single clicks no longer count exclusively → the multiplicator can be used to upgrade several attractions with one click and complete the task
o Hellevator
- You can buy a treat multiple times, and its durability can be increased to up to 24 floors
o Guild
- The secondary weapon slot displays a tooltip (for all classes that have an info screen) which points out that the info screen can be viewed with a click
o Reworked the Mage class graphics
o Sounds
- As the Druid uses his Mage weapons like a Warrior, every Mage weapon was assigned more suitable sounds

[b]Fixed bugs[/b]

o Bard
- When playing the harp, enemies can now block or evade a Bard’s critical attacks
o Daily to-do list
- The door icon of the Hydra task now correctly redirects you to the Hydra in the guild
o Expeditions (EU7)
- Hourglasses can now be used regularly in expeditions again, even if you have the exact number of hourglasses required in your inventory
o Missing tooltips
- The pets' armor tooltip is correctly displayed again
- Ability tooltip of the Berserker and Battle Mage classes are correctly displayed again
o Underworld
- When using the Adventuromatic, lasting class effects now correctly reset after every defeated enemy
o Wheel of Fortune
- You can spin the wheel up to 20 times with mushrooms again, even if no Lucky Coins are available

notes.title: Producer’s Note #14 - Change of the Demon Hunter Class Icon
notes.content:
After changing the class icon of the Berserker, we are now also giving the class icon of the Demon Hunter a new coat of paint and would like to explain how the new class icon came about.

[h3]Why the change?[/h3]
Since, similar to the Berserker, the class icon of the Demon Hunter only depicts a weapon (the crossbow), which does not reflect the class ability, we wanted to choose an icon that is familiar to you on the one hand and reflects the ability of this class on the other hand. Since the crossbow as a weapon is not solely used by the Demon Hunter (the Scout also uses crossbows), we wanted to change this.

[h3]What was important to us?[/h3]
We are aware that the changes to the existing class icons represent a major intervention in your gameplay. As with previous changes, the class icon of the Demon Hunter has emerged through many internal discussions and we have tried to stay as close as possible to the original vision of the Demon Hunter and to optimize it mainly.

In order to address the Demon Hunter's individual ability more closely with the class icon, we focused on his Elixir of Revival. Since this elixir visually resembles the large endurance potion (“Potion of the Long Distance Runner”) too much, we wanted to make a clearer distinction here to represent the uniqueness of the elixir. In addition to the shape of the bottle, we added white bat wings. These wings symbolize both the ability of the Demon Hunter to be able to resurrect after death, and his class-specific connection to the demon world.

[h3]Class Selection[/h3]
The visual representation of the Demon Hunter in the class selection has been expanded by giving him an aura of demonic wings to give him a special form and to emphasize his ability to resurrect. The bottles attached to the belt have also been adjusted in shape.

The red glow that previously surrounded the crossbow is not found in the color scheme in the artwork for the Demon Hunter. We have chosen a whitish glow, which surrounds the winged elixir in the class icon. This glow also surrounds the Demon Hunter in the class selection and ensures that the new class icon allows a clearer distinction from other class icons in the Hall of Fame, for example.

notes.title: Alternative Feature for Daily Tasks
notes.content:
We've been thinking about how we can make the checklist and the secret mission of the day more interesting and less monotonous. With more variance and a goal to work towards, we believe that motivation can be increased to devote oneself to daily tasks and to no longer view them as a necessary evil.
[h3]The Concept of Daily Tasks[/h3]
We have set the following requirements for ourselves in the development of the event:
[list]
[*] The checklist and the secret mission of the day should be completely replaced by the new feature.
[*] The tasks of the checklist should remain.
[*] Every game feature should be depicted and packaged into tasks.
[*] There should be fixed, daily tasks, as well as randomly generated ones with various goals, which should be comparable to the secret mission of the day.
[*] The rewards of the daily tasks should be based on the "secret mission of the day" and also scale with the heads of the Hydra.
[*] In addition to the daily tasks, there should be varied tasks that the player can fulfill over an event period from Monday to Thursday each week. This should give the player the opportunity to work towards something and make the gaming experience more varied. These tasks should mostly have an overarching theme.
[*] The rewards of the event tasks should depend on the respective event. However, the player should be able to earn another beer if enough tasks have been completed.
[/list]
Here you get a small glimpse of the tasks that can be completed: [url=https://bit.ly/DailyTasksBeta]https://bit.ly/DailyTasksBeta[/url].

notes.title: Producer's Note #13
notes.content:
It has been a while since server merges were discussed and enthusiastically announced. Due to the challenges we had to face during and after the backend migration, the topic of server consolidation fell somewhat into the background.

We are all the more pleased to announce that we have not been idle over the past few months and have been working on a concept together with community representatives. Now, as the first test merges look promising, we would like to provide you with more detailed information.

The goal of the server merges is clear. After 14 years, naturally older servers are not as active and by merging these servers we hope to ensure more rivalry and activity in the daily gameplay for the players who are still active there.
[h2]Concept[/h2]
Next, we briefly introduce our concept. Both technical aspects and aspects to ensure fair competition have been taken into account:
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Any number of servers can be merged.
[*] All characters will be transferred to a new server, the following rules apply:
[*] For each origin server, one character can be played on the merged server.
[*] Characters below level 10, which have not been active for a year and for which no money has been spent, will be deleted.
[/list]
[h3]Character Names[/h3]
In the case of multiple characters with the same name, these characters will be renamed. The following conditions apply:
[list]
[*] The character's name can be renamed once at the first login according to the usual rules.
[*] The rename is possible by using the old character data + old game world for a certain period of time to log in. If a character is connected to an S&F account, the login is done via this.
[/list]
[h3]Guilds[/h3]
Guilds will be transferred, provided there are still members after the character deletion (see above), but they must have a unique name.

If several guilds have the same name, these guilds will be renamed and can be renamed once by the guild leader.

The guild's honor corresponds to the old honor, but can be at most as high as the smallest honor value of a migrated top-1 guild.

If a guild leader is deleted, the officer with the highest level becomes the new guild leader; if there are no/further officers, the guild member with the highest level becomes the new guild leader.
[h3]Hall of Fame[/h3]
[list]
[*] The calculation for the Heroes' Hall of Fame is as follows: Honor/2, but at most as high as the honor value of the top-1 player of an old server with the lowest honor value.
[*] For all other Halls of Fame, the honor of the old server is adopted.
[*] The income that can be earned per day through Hall of Fame battles is limited to 100 million gold to prevent abusive behavior when multiple characters of a player have been moved.
[/list]
[h2]Communication[/h2]
On servers where a merge is imminent, a pop-up will be displayed daily for a certain period, pointing out the server merge. In addition, there will be an in-game message.

On the day of each server merge, a world will be frozen at midnight. As soon as the work in the background is completed, the characters on the new server will be released again.
[h2]Which servers will be merged?[/h2]
We will initially merge all US servers and the Canadian server. This is likely to happen at the end of July.

We will merge the aforementioned servers in a test merge, with the origin servers remaining parallel so that a data comparison is possible.

Creating a new character will not be possible on the new server during the test.

[b]Important![/b] We reserve the right to make changes to the concept if it should be necessary for compelling reasons!

[b]Survey Result Analysis[/b]
Approximately 30% of participants could agree with preventing guild departure, but a significant 54% were against it. The suggestions regarding the Hell Tokens being kept entirely within the guild or splitting them between the player and the guild when a player leaves got roughly 40% support each: 41% opposed the idea of keeping them entirely within the guild, while 25.5% opposed the idea of splitting them between the player and the guild when a player leaves.

Despite the aforementioned issue, the majority of the community seems to prefer the current system: nearly 48% favor the current system, while only 18% appear to disagree with it.

[b]Conclusion[/b]
We believe this is a clear vote in favor of maintaining the current system and not making any changes.

Once again, we would like to thank you for your input!

notes.title: Voting for New Berserker Class Icon
notes.content:
We recently changed the class icon of the Berserker, which might have caught you a bit by surprise. In the following, we would like to explain our reasons for doing so and also present a few more concepts and suggestions, about which we would love to hear your opinions!
[h3]Why do we want to change class icons at all?[/h3]
The redesign of the class icon stems from the desire to better represent the unique ability that distinguishes each class.

The Berserker's axe, which can also attack with all other hand weapons, does not capture its class; its defining ability is to mercilessly strike at its opponent in a state of frenzy, and we want to try to visualize this.

In the Hall of Fame, it's desirable to make the icons in the smaller version more readable and intuitively recognizable, so that at first glance it's clear which opponent one chooses.
[h3]What was important to us about the Berserker class icon?[/h3]
The icon of the Berserker is a special challenge because it is about representing an emotion, namely frenzy, which we associate with heat and fire, without giving the impression that the Berserker has a fire attack.

In addition to the class icon, there is the option to also adjust the effect if this better represents the effect of the ability, we tried to avoid this in the first step, but we do not rule it out!
[h3]What would we like to receive in terms of feedback?[/h3]
We are aware that the community has gotten used to a certain icon and it's unfortunate to have to relearn this icon for each class with every update, so we are now taking this path to better consider your feedback in the redesign process and to arrive at the best possible solution.

We would be pleased if you could take a look at the new icon ideas and their associated effects, and let us know what you like best. For this, we would like to ask you to participate in the following survey:

[url=https://forms.gle/28b8bB3jiF9FEdyU8]Voting for New Berserker Class Icon[/url]

Here is a sneak peak at what class icons we've come up with:

notes.title: Producer’s Note #12
notes.content:
The next closed beta test is up and coming. This time you will have the chance to explore a new event we have created, an alternative way to spent thirst for adventure: the expedition event. In this producer’s note you will get some more background information about why we developed this event.

Read the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/438040/view/3693561465121204814]announcement[/url] to get some more information about the closed beta details.

[h3]What are the goals of the new expedition event?[/h3]
Shakes & Fidget celebrates its 14th anniversary this summer, and the quests have been with us for just as long. They are an important feature of the game to let your character make progress every day.

We have realized that this consistent routine of consuming thirst for adventure every day doesn’t provide the fun many players want.

Instead of developing a new feature that would increase the daily playtime and would require an additional investment, we have come up with an alternative for spending thirst for adventure. We followed the following guidelines:

[list]
[*] In late game, it must mean fewer clicks to spend thirst for adventure than the current mechanic. Spamming the enter key must still work.
[*] The mount should not only decrease the waiting time, but also increase loot.
[*] Players should still be able to decide whether they would like to focus on resources or XP (to the same extent as it is currently implemented in the game).
[*] The loot you gain per thirst for adventure spent must remain the same.
[*] It’s supposed to feel like you are actually on a quest where you make decisions yourself to have more control over the outcome of the quest.
[*] An alternative method to spend thirst for adventure will be planned as an event during which you won’t find pet eggs, but dungeon keys.
[/list]

[h3]That’s why we developed expeditions![/h3]
Expeditions take the conditions mentioned above into account and we would like to test with the beta how this alternative to classic quests in the form of an event is received.

For this, we have introduced a new NPC, an elderly explorer who will lead expeditions during the event from the counter of the tavern.

Each expedition has a special task that will reward the player with extra heroism upon completion.

The mount reduces both waiting times per expedition and increases the rewards of the final score, but it does not decrease the thirst for adventure cost as classic quests do.

On a total of ten clearings, the player must pick one encounter each to advance. Spending thirst for adventure on expeditions unlocks new encounters only after a certain number in order not to overwhelm the player.

For more information on expeditions, please read the article in our help center: [url=https://bit.ly/Beta08Info]https://bit.ly/Beta08Info[/url].

notes.title: Producer’s Note #11
notes.content:
One account to access them all! With the new S&F account which we are going to introduce with the update 15.500 you will be able to play all your Shakes & Fidget characters with only one access.

[h3]What’s the Benefit?[/h3]
Once you have created your S&F account you will be able to connect all your existing Shakes & Fidget characters to it and, of course, you will be able to create new characters with this account as well. Meaning, you will only need one login to access and to manage all of your characters. The S&F account can be used on all platforms, no matter if you would like to play in your most favorite browser, mobile or on Steam.

We offer the usual login methods for the S&F account, e.g. email and password, Steam ID, Facebook and many more (depending on the chosen device you would like to use to register). We recommend you to use email and password as this login method will be available on all devices, no matter which platform. After creating an S&F account you will have the possibility to add additional authentication methods as well.

Character validation will also be easier with the S&F account. You only need to validate your S&F account and all characters you create using the S&F account, or which you connect to it, will be validated automatically.

[h3]Did I Hear Free Mushrooms?[/h3]
Create your S&F account as soon as it is available and connect your characters to it. Each character you will connect to your S&F account will get 15 mushrooms for free!

[h3]Learn More About the S&F Account in Our Help Center[/h3]
We have created an extensive FAQ for the S&F account which you will find [url=https://playa-games.helpshift.com/hc/section/20-s-f-account/]here[/url]. It should answer all your questions.

notes.title: Producer's Note #10
notes.content:
The topic we will be talking about today may be surprising. We are going to increase our pricing for the first time within the 13 years long Shakes & Fidget history, except of adjustments due to currency fluctuations.

Before you rage out about price increasements during inflation, please read the whole producer’s note to understand our motivation and why this does not mean that purchases will be more expensive per se.

[h3]Which Prices Will Be Increased and Why?[/h3]

We are going to increase prices in the mobile apps (Android & iOS) as well as in Steam. In the past, all three platforms had different price points, those will now be aligned.

Price increasements are necessary as the company structure has changed. From a small developer team of only seven people the team size increased to 35 employees within the last two years to ensure the operation of Shakes & Fidget as well as guaranteeing the future of the game. Additionally, this allows us to work on new products to diversify the company’s portfolio. Due to that the personnel cost increased significantly.

[h3]And What’s the Good News?[/h3]

Although prices will be increased this does not necessarily mean that you need to pay more than before. With the introduction of the WebShop (https://home.sfgame.net) we found a way to maintain our pricing but provide a possibility to you to purchase items outside of the game.

Together with the WebShop we are going to establish a Community Portal. This should be the place to go for the community in the future to find interesting information all around the game and a convenient option to purchase mushrooms and special packs, and last but not least special sales will be offered as well from time to time.

Find out more about the WebShop and the Community Portal here: [url=https://home.sfgame.net/]https://home.sfgame.net/[/url].

notes.title: Producer’s Note #9
notes.content:
With the introduction of the new backend we have experienced some unexpected problems with the game stability and performance. We have been asked how we do address such issues and how we deal with those to provide a flawless gaming experience to you. Let’s shed some light into it.

Since the introduction of the new backend we are using a different architecture than before. We do now work with real databases to be able to store data in a better way instead of using a simple CSV file. In addition, there are other new technologies that enable cool features in the game, but also affect performance. Now, we have a very modern server but it works completely different than with the old backend.

We undertook countless measures since the new backend release to improve server stability. Unfortunately, it is not enough to simply write code that is easy to understand. Our developers also have to make sure that the CPU can handle the code, that the internal as well as the external network traffic is not burdened by it, that it is not written too much into the memory, and that the hard disks are not being disabled with too many accesses. Thanks to our sysadmins, we have access to a very good monitoring which displays data in a telemetry tool. This enables us to detect anomalies relatively easy.

In addition to the telemetry tool, we use another tool which analyzes the source code from the server and breaks down understandably which classes and functions are called in which order - and how these affect the various hardware components. In a simplified way we can see which incoming requests take a long time, or are called too often - and where optimizations can be done. Unfortunately, the tool itself has not been in use that long, but it has already proven its worthiness and is now included in the quality assurance process.

With the help of this tool, we are currently revising each request in all constellations to check which ones may take too long. Those will be investigated further to see what can be improved. We do this step by step and the resulting performance optimizations will be deployed in several updates.

We have to admit that the old architecture was much faster and decently more stable because it relied on protocols that we cannot and do not want to use in the new game server anymore. The disadvantage was that we had a lot of servers in the old system and it had its technical limitations which for example did not allow us to implement specific new features. PHP also has its limits, but we know workarounds and – vice versa – how to get more out of it.

We have already achieved a lot of stability and performance improvements with the last updates, but we also see that we can still optimize in various areas and we will do so.

notes.title: Producer's Note #8
notes.content:
With this producer’s note we would like to provide some insights about the strategy for Shakes & Fidget.

Our goal for the years to come is to modernize Shakes & Fidget. We would like to create a better first time experience to increase accessibility for new players by providing a better guidance and feature explanation, incl. more transparency regarding the balancing. In addition, old features will be reworked to make them more fun and less repetitive for both, veterans and newbies.

As we see more and more players joining our game on mobile apps, we strive to optimize the gameplay experience for those. But this does not mean that we will not pay attention to the classic browser version or the Steam client anymore.

[h3]Dungeon Rework[/h3]
A good example to demonstrate our approach to modernize Shakes & Fidget would be the dungeons rework. The goal was make the feature to look more appealing, to be more transparent, to provide a better guidance, and to provide new content.

To achieve a more welcoming appearance we reworked the dungeon overview as well as the dungeon maps which have now themed buildings matching the dungeon’s monsters. All dungeons which are on the same map do now work the same way, containing ten floors each and do not have any special functionality. Special dungeons got their own space in the dungeon overview.

More transparency and better guidance was achieved by providing information about the dungeon unlock conditions directly on the map, displaying the opponent’s class and elemental damage as well as the last and the next opponent. Furthermore, when entering a dungeon map, the dungeon with the monster having the lowest level of all open dungeons will be preselected.

New content was implemented with the launch of 10 new dungeons (5 each for the light and shadow world).

Detaching the Continuous Loop of Idols for example provides us the possibility to extend this feature in the future. The same intention has the redesign of the dungeon maps. Separating the special dungeons also allowed us to display all needed information about their functionality on the first sight.

The navigation was changed to be more mobile friendly while still being comfortable to be used on PC, following common pattern for the latter while still improving the game’s handling on mobile apps.

[h3]Open Beta Tests[/h3]
You may have noticed that we did not run any open beta tests lately while still launching new or reworked features.

The new dungeons were not open beta tests as we did not see the necessity for a public beta test and we did not want to ruin the surprise of the dungeon’s release and their content.

Anyhow, we have learned our lesson from releasing the rebalanced druid without a previous open beta test. Not running a beta test was a mistake and, thus, we are working on a new and better system to run beta tests for future releases.

We have learned that the community’s feedback is important and very valuable when it comes to reworks and rebalancing. Keep your eyes open for the next open beta test and help us to make Shakes & Fidget becoming even more fun in the upcoming year(s).

[h3]International Servers[/h3]
The news of discontinuing the launch of international servers hit some of you unexpectedly and we would like to shed some light on that decision.

First of all, we will still launch new servers in the future but the naming will be different.

Currently, 95% of our players are from Central Europe but we would like to expand to other continents as well. To ensure that players on other continents will be able to play with a good performance, we will set up servers located on the respective continent and the naming will adapt to that location. Taking this into consideration, the naming of international servers would be misleading.

notes.title: Producer’s Note #7
notes.content:
With great interest, we followed the controverse discussion about the rebalanced druid. While doing so we observed that the changes seem to have overshoot the mark. It was not our intention to displease you with these changes. Well, it seems that it has indeed come to such a situation and we would like to apologize for that.

According to your feedback our game design reviewed the druid’s numbers, reassessed those and adjusted the balancing. With the publication of this producer’s note, the changes are likely to be deployed already.

Please keep in mind that the numbers have been changed in the game engine but it may take some more time until the correct numbers of each form will be displayed in the game. While we are able to change numbers in the background, for graphical adjustments we need to create a new client.

Unfortunately, we had to realize that it would have been better to do a public test the rebalanced druid on a beta server like it was done with the bard for example. We acknowledge, we made a mistake and in the future we will incorporate the community in such processes.

The changes are as follows:

[list]
[*] In fights against mages and bards, the druid now only deals 50% of the original damage.
[*] Tiger form: swoop damage bonus when dealing critical damage was reduced to 200% and the chance to dodge was reduced to 35%.
[*] Eagle form: swoop damage bonus with dive attack was reduced to 400% and the chance on repeating dive attacks will now decrease by 5% per performed dive attack.
[/list]

There may be situations where the dodging behavior of the druid may not be working as intended. This problem will be fixed next week latest.

Despite of the inconveniences caused, we go ahead and wish you a happy weekend!
